articles.title: Apple is closing in on Nvidia as it looks to reclaim title of largest U.S. company
articles.description: Once the face of the AI trade, Nvidia’s valuation has compressed to levels not seen since 2013 while Apple shares continue to power higher

articles.title: As chip sector takes it on the chin, traders bet on a big Nvidia rally
articles.description: Shares of Nvidia fought into the green despite a 5% sell-off in chip stocks tracked by the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH).

articles.title: Chinese lidar maker with Nvidia ties accused of being cyber risk for U.S.
articles.description: Hesai Technology was blacklisted as a national security threat in 2024 by the U.S. Department of Defense, which designated Hesai as a Chinese military entity.
